name: Video-MME
description: A comprehensive video understanding benchmark spanning full-spectrum evaluation of perception, comprehension, and adaptation across diverse video durations — from 11 seconds to 1 hour — across 6 primary domains and 30 subfields. Tests integration of video frames, subtitles, and audio. Assesses both short-form and long-form video understanding with temporal reasoning.
typical_sota_score: ~60–75% (top models as of 2025; sharp drops on longer videos)
reputation: Industry standard for video understanding evaluation; adopted by OpenAI and Google in 2024 model evaluations; presented at CVPR 2025; first comprehensive benchmark covering short to long videos across diverse domains
notes: First comprehensive benchmark covering videos from 11 seconds to 1 hour. Reveals sharp performance degradation on longer videos. Adopted by OpenAI and Google in official model evaluations. Presented at CVPR 2025. Covers diverse content: knowledge (arts, sports, science), examination-style questions, and real-world scenarios. Provides with/without subtitle variants.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
